mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the average forward return is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6.0% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary policy easing, thereby boosting equity valuations via lower discount rates and improved risk appetite over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 6.0% for three consecutive months, SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or occur in fewer than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1.7 million units over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and a contraction in residential investment, which triggers a risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1700.0 for two months, SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or occur in fewer than 55% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 105.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, which increases the probability of a recession and triggers a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO remains below 105.0 for two months, SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or occur in fewer than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signal a broad-based collapse in consumer demand, which increases the likelihood of a policy response and triggers a risk-on reversal in equity markets, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 1700.0 and RSAFS < 615000.0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS fall below thresholds for two months, SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or occur in fewer than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% combined with a CPI reading above 265.0 signals a tightening monetary cycle under high inflation, which increases the risk of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 265.0, SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or occur in fewer than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% signals a labor market deterioration that increases the probability of a policy pivot, leading to positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days due to improved risk appetite.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines > 50k and UNRATE > 6.0% in the same month
regime_hint: labor market deterioration with policy pivot
failure_condition: When PAYEMS drops >50k and UNRATE >6.0% in the same month, SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or occur in fewer than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized growth combined with a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1.7 million signals a late-cycle economic slowdown, which triggers a flight to safety and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 < 1.5% annualized and HOUST < 1700.0, SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or occur in fewer than 55% of such instances.
